GDScript grammar from https://github.com/highlightjs/highlightjs-gdscript,
`master/src/languages/gdscript.js`, retrieved 5 November 2026. BSD-3-Clause license
is retained in LICENSE. Converted its CommonJS export to ES module syntax; the
caller augments keywords/annotations for Godot 4. Highlight.js core is pinned in
package.json. Source code text is never executed by this highlighter.
